pyarrow.Field<node_id: int32>
pyarrow.Field<parent_id: int64>

morphology.nblast_note: Scores are rounded to four decimal places and negative scores clipped to zero by the publishers.

manifest.edge_encoding: directed CSR; targets are uint32 node indexes; counts are uint32
manifest.neurotransmitter_encoding: uint8 six-channel score; divide by 255; consult sources.connections.neurotransmitter_semantics
manifest.node_id_encoding: little-endian uint64; JSON IDs are decimal strings
manifest.region_handling: neuropil rows combined per ordered neuron pair; six transmitter channels weighted by syn_count

connections.neurotransmitter_semantics: Source nt_type is one categorical prediction per row. Six graph channels are one-hot encodings of that category, averaged by synapse count when neuropils are merged; they are not source probability estimates.
connections.preexisting_filter: Filtered Codex export: in this exact file, every ordered neuron pair has at least five synapses across neuropils; individual neuropil rows may have fewer.

codex_graph.source_warning: Codex Princeton export is already filtered to neuron pairs with at least five synapses across neuropils; graph min_synapses_per_edge=1 cannot restore omitted pairs.
codex_graph.nt_warning: Six CSR channels encode synapse-weighted averages of categorical nt_type one-hot labels, not the Zenodo per-synapse/edge transmitter probabilities.
